newsitem.title: USA: Transit sees profit, adds acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Transit sees profit, adds acquisitions.

text.p: Transit Group Inc said Monday that due to recent acquisitions in the trucking area, it believes it is positioned for profitable operations during the second half of fiscal 1997.

The company said as part of its acquisition plan, effective Aug 15, it acquired Capital Warehouse Inc, based in Louisville, Kentucky, and Service Express Inc, based in Tuscaloosa, Alabama. The two companies have annual revenues of about $16 million and $5 million, respectively, it said.
Carolina Pacific Distributors Inc was acquired last month, the company said.

Transit said the completion of the three acquisitions has added about $35 million in annual base revenues and assuming the Carroll Fulmer acquisition is finalized, it will exceed $100 million in annual revenues.
In connection with its new strategic direction, Transit said it intends to dispose of its parcel delivery and courier businesses in the third quarter of 1997.
Under the terms of the two acquisitions, Transit Group has issued a total of about 1.54 million new shares of common stock valued at about $9.85 million.

Transit said it has a definitive agreement to acquire Carroll Fulmer Group Inc, a Groveland, Florida-based privately-held company that generates about $70 million in annual revenues. The transaction is expected to be completed by Sept 1 and Transit expects to issue 4,166,000 shares of common stock, it said.
